name: journals
description: Your AI cannot skip your journal: before your AI touches, builds or answers about anything, it sees that thing's map (journal, decisions, what exists, latest, pending) and the tools that already do the job; the first touch of a file in a project with a journal carries its journal brief, a default rules pack stops the classic disasters (leaked keys, wiping deletes, force push to main) with no setup, and your exact rules stop what breaks them.
